name: Ruth Díaz
bio:
Ruth Díaz Muriedas es una actriz de cine, teatro y televisión española.

Comenzó en un grupo aficionado, Corocotta Teatro. Llegó a Madridcon una Fortunata y Jacinta en el Teatro Español y se quedó. Ha estudiado en la Escuela de Arte Dramático. Se licencia por la R.E.S.A.D.en la especialidad de interpretación. Ha cursado estudios con Juan Carlos Corazzay con Fernando Piernas entre otros. También ha realizado estudios de técnica vocal expresiva con Beatriz Pardo.

En 2013 se lanza a la dirección, siendo Porsiemprejamón su opera prima como guionista y directora. Se trata de un cortometraje que ha recibido numerosos premios.

credits.title: Amira
credits.overview: In the XVIII Century there’s a music school where it’s always dark.

credits.title: The Wait
credits.overview: Eladio, hunting estate keeper, takes a bribe from a veteran hunter. Weeks later, his whole life falls apart. What looked like the opportunity of a lifetime, turns into a macabre descent to hell when he finds out that his misfortune might not be entirely by chance.

credits.title: 13 Exorcisms
credits.overview: After participating in a séance, young Laura begins to behave strangely. Alarmed, her parents ask Father Olmedo, one of the few exorcists authorized by the Vatican to intervene in cases of demonic possession, for help.

credits.title: The Sleep of the Dogs
credits.overview: Night falls in the wasteland. Esther tries to protect her son Caesar, who has been attacked by a creature of the night. But the boy disappears and Esther goes off to search for him with her hunting dogs and crossbow.

credits.title: Once Upon a Time in Euskadi
credits.overview: Basque Country, Spain, 1985. Four teenage friends must face life and death, social upheaval and political violence as they try to enjoy their summer vacation.

credits.title: A Normal World
credits.overview: Ernesto learns that his mother has passed and yet worse that they plan to bury her in a graveyard. Determined to fulfill his late mum's wishes, he plans to steal the coffin.

credits.title: The Occupant
credits.overview: An unemployed executive is forced to sell his apartment. When he discovers that he still has the keys, he becomes obsessed with the family that now lives there and decides to recover the life he has lost, at any price.

credits.title: Goodbye
credits.overview: Seville, Spain. Juan Santos, a convicted petty criminal, gets out of jail for a day to celebrate with Triana, his wife, the first communion of their daughter Estrella.

credits.title: The (Silent) War
credits.overview: Northern Spain, October 1944. Several groups of guerrilla fighters, former Republican soldiers exiled in France after the end of the Spanish Civil War, infiltrate the country in order to provoke a popular uprising against General Franco's dictatorship.

credits.title: A March to Remember
credits.overview: Vitoria, Basque Country, Spain, March 3, 1976. After several months of protests demanding decent working conditions, a general strike is called. Thousands of workers gather at the church of San Francisco while a hundred heavily armed policemen wait to act.

credits.title: The Skin of the Wolf

He only goes down to the valleys twice a year to trade and to buy provisions. credits.title: Miss Wamba
credits.overview: A woman tormented by her past meets an old man with whom she immediately connects.

credits.title: The Fury of a Patient Man
credits.overview: Quiet Jose woos cafe worker Ana, but she is unaware he has intentions other than the purely romantic.

credits.title: Behind
credits.overview: A divorced mother is obsessed with the idea that her ex-husband is plotting to take her baby away from her.

credits.title: Los días no vividos
credits.overview: David (Javier Godino) is awakened by the startling news of the imminent end of the world, and decides to spend his last hours with his friend Jaime (Axier Etxeandia), but he finds Silvia (Ingrid Rubio), a prostitute newcomer to Madrid to rebuild her live.

credits.title: The Curse
credits.overview: A group of young people with powers to save the world is hunted by the secret service.

credits.title: The Appeared
credits.overview: One night Malena and Pablo, a sister and brother traveling together in Argentina, discover a diary that details crimes committed twenty years ago.

credits.title: The Dreyer Cycle
credits.overview: Madrid, Spain, 1961, during the Franco regime. Carlos, a law student who runs a film club, decides to organize a cycle dedicated to the movies of Danish filmmaker Carl Theodor Dreyer.

credits.title: To Let
credits.overview: Mario and Clara, his pregnant girlfriend, try to find a new apartment to settle in as soon as possible, so they go to visit one in a distant neighborhood that seems abandoned. Once there, things are not as they expected.

credits.title: El Calentito
credits.overview: Early 80's, Sara is a good-family girl, she has never been with a man, does not drinks, does not take drugs. Following her love, she enters in "El Calentito" a bar where the group "las Siux" is singing.
